lobby.title: Meet in the courtyard
lobby.explanation: Create a room and share its invitation, or enter the code from your friend.
lobby.codeHint: Use eight letters or digits from the invitation.

interruption.participantLeft: The other player left the room.
interruption.connectionLost: The other player lost their connection.
interruption.serverOverloaded: The round stopped because the server is busy.
interruption.internalError: The round stopped because of a server error.

connection.disconnected: Choose how to enter a room.

arena.label: Grenadiers courtyard
arena.failure: The courtyard could not be drawn. Leave the room and try again.
arena.focusHint: Select the courtyard to control your player.
arena.instructions: Move with the arrow keys or W A S D. Place a bomb with Space. Controls work only during a live round.

error.title: Could not complete that action
error.connectionFailed: The game connection ended. Create or join a room to try again.
error.invalidServerMessage: The server sent game data this version cannot use.
error.sessionFailed: A game session could not be created. Try again.
error.sequenceExhausted: This connection reached its command limit. Start a new session.
error.incompatibleProtocol: This game version is not supported by the server.
error.invalidMessage: The server could not understand that command.
error.authenticationFailed: This game session is no longer valid. Start a new one.
error.connectionInUse: This game session is already open elsewhere.
error.notAuthenticated: The game connection is not ready yet.
error.alreadyAuthenticated: This connection is already signed in.
error.alreadyInRoom: Leave the current room before joining another.
error.notInRoom: Join a room before using that control.
error.roomNotFound: That room is no longer available.
error.roomFull: Both seats in that room are occupied.
error.staleRoom: The room changed before that command arrived.
error.invalidPhase: That action is not available at this point in the round.
error.staleSequence: That command arrived out of order. Try the action again.
error.duplicateAction: That bomb action was already received.
error.rateLimited: Commands are arriving too quickly. The connection was stopped.
error.capacityReached: The server has no room for another game right now.
